How To Conduct User Research In The Prototype Stage For Your Game
Sarah Impey
Last updated: Aug 19, 2026

Learn how to validate your game concept early with user research, A/B testing, and surveys to maximize market success.
Whether it’s your game concept or your core game features, prototyping and testing ideas at an early stage can you let you know a lot about the health of your game, and more specifically, if people are actually going to enjoy it.Ideally, you’ll want to make sure your title is popular the moment it hits the market. Not only is testing in the early stages of development good for getting your game out there, but it can also help you focus your production process on features that will make the most impact on your intended audience.In this post, you’ll find the steps you need to take when conducting user research during that all-important prototype phase. We’ll include a bunch of different examples of specific test methods (with pros and cons of each) as well as advice for pulling together your very own test plan.This is a bit of a lengthy post, so feel free to skip to a specific section if you’re looking for something in particular:

WEBTOON Is Bigger Than Monopoly Go: Inside a New Game Marketing Channel
营销
8月19日
作者
Aylin Yazıcı
营销人员正在努力寻找新的渠道。WEBTOON的Christine Yoo和Square Enix的Melanie Gordon解释了为什么一个漫画应用应该被列入名单：1.569亿读者，其中69%是游戏玩家，而且这个产品已经在每周带来1万个经过验证的Steam愿望单添加。

收听DoF的
Jen Donahoe
与
Christine Yoo
和
Melanie Gordon
的完整对话。

各地的营销人员都撞上了同一堵墙。用户获取已经饱和，行业一直在绕同一个问题打转：你在哪里找到新渠道，你还能在哪里真正找到用户。

WEBTOON是一个很好的答案，而游戏行业几乎没有人谈论它。它同时触达移动端、PC和主机端，Square Enix、Blizzard和Krafton都已经在悄悄与之合作。Christine Yoo，WEBTOON品牌合作总监，负责向发行商销售这些合作项目。Melanie Gordon，Square Enix高级营销经理，已经在WEBTOON上运营了两个campaign，分别是《Visions of Mana》和《Dragon Quest VII Reimagined》。以下是营销人员应该从他们构建的内容中汲取的要点。

要点1：WEBTOON已经拥有营销人员追逐的游戏受众
WEBTOON在全球拥有1.569亿月读者，其中69%在移动端、主机和PC上玩游戏。这意味着大约有1.08亿读者同时也是游戏玩家，而他们就在这个大多数游戏营销人员从未直接投放过的平台上。

查看大图
来源：Sensor Tower，一级西方市场MAU 2026年7月
这个规模与营销人员已经在购买的渠道相比毫不逊色。在一级西方市场——大部分游戏营销预算实际花在的地方——WEBTOON的移动应用截至2026年7月已触达2120万读者，超过Paramount+、Candy Crush和Monopoly Go!。如果专门与移动游戏对比，它在西方市场排名第9。

查看大图
参与度支撑了规模。读者每天在应用内花费约30分钟，这使得WEBTOON的平台使用时长介于Snap和Facebook之间。如此庞大的游戏受众，以与营销人员已经在购买投放的社交平台相匹配的速率参与互动，这种组合使得这个渠道值得认真审视。

这种规模使其成为一个恰好通过漫画触达的游戏受众。

要点2：受众是西方用户，常规假设是错的
很容易将其视为一个面向东方受众的东方平台。收入数据乍一看也支持这一点，韩国和日本上个季度贡献了9350万美元和1.36亿美元的付费内容，而世界其他地区仅为3450万美元。但西方才是读者和广告库存真正所在的地方。WEBTOON进入美国已经超过10年，超过75%的北美用户是Z世代，约90%在34岁以下。

还有两个假设经不起数据的检验。性别比例为60%女性和40%男性，Christine的一句话打破了显而易见的解读：
"我们的受众大约是60%女性和40%男性。因为我们大多数非常受欢迎的作品都是从爱情题材起家的，所以我们看到更多女性受众。但令人惊讶的是，你看到的是更多女性受众，但她们全都是游戏玩家。"
—— Christine Yoo

题材构成也不仅仅是动漫和JRPG。Christine的团队在读者中发现了第一人称射击、大逃杀、模拟、开放世界、恐怖和生存类游戏的玩家，这就是为什么Blizzard的《Overwatch: Undivided》——一部40集的品牌系列内容——获得了240万独立观看和超过2000条评论。

无论营销人员对谁在读WEBTOON以及他们玩什么游戏持有何种假设，数据很可能都会反驳它。

要点3：该形式的表现堪比付费媒体
Square Enix在WEBTOON上运营了两个campaign，两者的表现都超过了媒体计划真正被衡量的数字。《Visions of Mana》以品牌番外篇的形式运营，即在一章最后一格之后的空间里推出的衍生内容，围绕一个漫画和游戏共有的角色构建。它产生了630万次曝光，124%的页面浏览提升，点击率超出基准184%。《Dragon Quest VII Reimagined》使用了Tabletop格式，即与游戏手工艺术风格相匹配的四格迷你冒险。在两个campaign中，Mel的单次点击成本都优于Square Enix自身的认知度基准。

查看大图
这些内容之所以看起来像原生内容而不是赞助内容，部分原因在于供给侧，而不仅仅是读者侧。创作这些合作内容的创作者本身就是玩家。Christine的团队推介一个作品时，得到的是粉丝式的回应：

"当我们带着一个作品去接洽时，就像在说，嘿，我们有Square Enix，有即将推出的《Dragon Quest VII》，然后他们的反应是，天哪，我要做这个。我太兴奋了，我是粉丝。我们喜欢这种反应，因为创作者越投入，他们带来的附加价值就越大。他们才是最了解自己故事和这款游戏的人。"
—— Christine Yoo，描述创作者的回应

这种重叠也是为什么创意不必局限于平台上。S

WEBTOON Is Bigger Than Monopoly Go: Inside a New Game Marketing Channel
Marketing
Aug 19
Written By
Aylin Yazıcı
Marketers are struggling to find new channels. WEBTOON's Christine Yoo and Square Enix's Melanie Gordon explain why a comics app belongs on the list: 156.9M readers, 69% of them gamers, and a product already driving 10K verified Steam wishlist adds a week.
Listen to DoF's
Jen Donahoe
's full conversation with
Christine Yoo
and
Melanie Gordon
.
Marketers everywhere are running into the same wall. UA is saturated, and the industry keeps circling the same 2 questions: where do you find a new channel, and where do you actually find people anymore.
WEBTOON is a good answer, and almost nobody in games is talking about it. It reaches mobile, PC, and console all at once, and Square Enix, Blizzard, and Krafton have all quietly been working with it already. Christine Yoo, Director of Brand Partnerships at WEBTOON, sells these programs to publishers. Melanie Gordon, a Senior Marketing Manager at Square Enix, has run 2 campaigns with WEBTOON, on Visions of Mana and Dragon Quest VII Reimagined. Here is what marketers should take from what they built.
Takeaway 1: WEBTOON already has the gaming audience marketers are chasing
WEBTOON has 156.9M monthly readers globally, and 69% of them play games, across mobile, console, and PC. That is roughly 108M readers who are also gamers, sitting inside a platform most game marketers have never targeted directly.
View fullsize
Source: Sensor Tower, Tier 1 West MAU July 2026
The scale holds up against channels marketers already buy. In Tier 1 Western markets, where most game marketing budgets actually get spent, WEBTOON's mobile app reached 21.2M readers as of Jul 2026, more than Paramount+, Candy Crush, or Monopoly Go!. Line it up against mobile games specifically and it ranks 9th in the West.
View fullsize
Engagement backs up the size. Readers spend about 30 minutes a day in the app, putting WEBTOON's time on platform between Snap and Facebook. A gaming audience this large, engaging at a rate that matches the social platforms marketers already buy, is the combination that makes this channel worth a serious look.
That scale makes this a gaming audience that happens to arrive through comics.
Takeaway 2: The audience is Western, and the usual assumptions are wrong
It would be easy to write this off as an Eastern platform for an Eastern audience. The revenue data supports that at first glance, Korea and Japan carried $93.5M and $136M in paid content last quarter against $34.5M for the rest of the world. But the West is where the readers and the ad inventory actually are. WEBTOON has been in the US for more than 10 years, more than 75% of its North American users are Gen Z, and about 90% are under 34.
Two more assumptions do not survive the data. The gender split is 60% female and 40% male, and Christine's line undercuts the obvious read:
"We have about 60% female and 40% male audience. Because most of our very popular titles started as romance titles, we saw more of a female audience. But what's surprising is, you see a more female audience, but they're all still gamers."
— Christine Yoo
The genre mix is not just anime and JRPG either. Christine's team found first person shooters, battle royale, simulation, open world, horror, and survival among readers, which is why Blizzard's Overwatch: Undivided, a 40-episode branded series, pulled 2.4M unique views and more than 2K comments.
Whatever assumption a marketer holds about who reads WEBTOON and what they play, the data probably contradicts it.
Takeaway 3: The format performs like paid media
Square Enix ran 2 campaigns on WEBTOON, and both beat the numbers a media plan is actually judged on. Visions of Mana ran as a branded epilogue, a spin-off in the space after a chapter's last panel, built around a character shared between the comic and the game. It generated 6.3M impressions, a 124% page view lift, and click-through 184% above benchmark. Dragon Quest VII Reimagined used Tabletop, 4-panel mini adventures matched to the game's handcrafted art style. On both campaigns, Mel's cost per click beat Square Enix's own awareness benchmarks.
View fullsize
Part of why these read as authentic instead of sponsored is supply-side, not just reader-side. The creators building these collabs are already players. Christine's team pitches a title and gets a fan's reaction back:
"When we reach out with a title, it's like, hey, we have Square Enix, we have a Dragon Quest VII that's coming out, and they're like, oh my god, I want to do it. I'm so excited, I'm a fan. We love that reaction, because the more the creators are engaged, the more they bring added value. They're the ones who know best, their own story and the game."
— Christine Yoo, describing creator response
That overlap is also why the creative does not have to stay locked on the platform. Square Enix reused the Dragon Quest VII creator's work on Instagram and saw a 91% lift on its own page, a second source of UA beyond whatever the placement itself delivered.
It's done so well that we are like, when can we partner next?"
— Melanie Gordan
This channel performs like paid media, and the reason runs through both sides of the transaction, the readers and the creators.
Takeaway 4: It is faster to execute than the usual objection assumes
Marketers skip custom content because they assume it eats the calendar. It does not, at least not here. A branded epilogue, the Square Enix format, takes 1 to 1.5 months. These full-size ads turn higher CPMs that can reach $10. If placed correctly, they can be less annoying to the users compared to banners.
#3 More games button
An easy way to get money from bigger gaming vendors. The user clicks on the button and gets a list of related games he might be interested in.
#4 Game Exit
Once the user finishes playing, you can present him one last full size ad.
#5 Icon drop
This option is available only on Android. The idea is simple, your game is authorised to send push messages to the user and these can be used to promote other games.

苹果公司再次更新了其欧洲版应用商店的政策，此举源于与欧盟委员会就其欧盟“守门人”地位展开的诉讼程序。

- 从其他商店或网站下载的应用的佣金将为5%。

苹果强调，新政策将仅适用于欧盟内部。这不会改变其他地区的佣金。

苹果还提醒道，尽管从2024年开始，欧盟的iOS将正式允许从替代商店和开发者网站直接安装应用，但第三方平台将受到严格标准的约束。现在，这些标准将被扩大。例如，拥有应用的应用商店和网站所有者如果在公开市场上市、此前曾吸引主要风险投资公司的投资，或已通过“持牌会计师”的财务审计，将能够获得iOS的访问权限。

此前，苹果曾在2025年6月更新欧洲App Store的规则，但当时因其创新过于复杂而受到批评，最终未能解决与欧盟委员会的分歧。

The Apple Corporation has once again
updated
the policy of the European version of its app store, prompted by proceedings with the European Commission regarding its “gatekeeper” status in the EU.
The changes mainly concern the App Store commission. Here’s what will change:
The standard commission for apps using the App Store’s payment system will be reduced to 26%;
The commission for purchases through third-party payment systems will be 20%. If apps are created by participants in the Small Business Program, meaning developers with an annual income of less than $1 million, the rate will decrease to 10%. The same rate will apply for participants in the Mini Apps Partner Program and the Video Partner Program;
The commission for apps where developers have added links to external payments will be 15%. For the aforementioned program participants, it will be lower—10%;
The commission for apps downloaded from other stores or websites will be 5%.
Apple emphasized that the new policy will apply exclusively within the EU. It does not change the commission in other regions.
Apple also reminded that although starting in 2024, iOS in the EU will formally allow the installation of apps from alternative stores and directly from developer websites, third-party platforms will be subject to strict criteria. Now, these criteria will be expanded. For example, store and website owners with apps will be able to gain access to iOS if they are publicly traded, have previously attracted investments from major venture firms, or have undergone a financial audit by a “licensed accountant.”
The new policy will take effect on October 1, 2026. More details about these and other changes can be read
on the Apple website
.
Previously, Apple updated the rules of the European App Store in June 2025, but was then criticized for the excessive complexity of the innovations and ultimately failed to resolve the dispute with the European Commission.

Pokémon TCG Pocket 收入下滑冲击 Dena 财务
日本游戏开发商 Dena 表示，在最新财务报告中，其游戏业务收入同比下降 33%，主要受到 Pokémon TCG Pocket 收入下滑的拖累。
尽管 Dena 旗舰游戏的收入有所下降，但 MAU 仍相对稳定在 2300 万，略低于上一季度平均 2400 万的水平。
据 AppMagic 估算，该游戏的 IAP 月收入已从 2025 年大部分时间的约 4000 万至 4500 万美元下滑至 2026 年上半年的约 2500 万美元。数据还显示，6 月和 7 月 IAP 收入进一步下滑，自 2024 年底上线以来首次月均跌破 2000 万美元。

CrazyLabs 的 Sled Surfers 推动 Embracer 移动业务增长
Embracer 第一财季净销售额同比增长 24%，达到 4.14 亿美元（39.43 亿瑞典克朗），现金 EBIT 由一年前的 -1040 万美元（-9900 万瑞典克朗）扭转为 490 万美元（4700 万瑞典克朗）。

在 Embracer 板块内，公司表示，其移动业务的净销售额和盈利能力均持续增长，这主要得益于 CrazyLabs 的 Sled Surfers——不过与整个移动行业一样，Embracer 的财报并未单独披露具体数字。

KLab 和 gumi 的 roguelite 英雄动作游戏 My Hero Academia: United Survival 于 8 月 6 日全球上线后一周内，全球下载量突破 100 万。
为了庆祝这一里程碑，两家工作室正在举办登录奖励活动，在 8 月 31 日前发放角色招募券。

Nexon 援引了部分通过近期投资撤资积累的 52 亿美元（8420 亿日元）现金储备，宣布派发每股 415 日元的特别股息，总价值约 20 亿美元（3240 亿日元），有待 9 月董事会批准，这将使公司自 2011 年 IPO 以来的股东总回报在年底前超过 56 亿美元（9000 亿日元）。

AppMagic 称射击类游戏在 Q2 中核品类收入增长中领先
AppMagic 的《Midcore Insights》2026 年第二季度报告估计，射击类游戏是唯一实现收入同比增长的主要中核品类，增长 13.9% 至 8.453 亿美元，而 RPG（-16.9%）、策略（-10.2%）和模拟（-14.8%）均出现下滑。
虽然策略品类的下载量有所增长，但收入并未跟上。卡牌对战类游戏收入估计下降 50.7%，尽管安装量持平，这主要是由于 Pokémon TCG Pocket 的下滑。
AppMagic 还指出，更多 4X 游戏——包括 Whiteout Survival 和 Puzzles & Survival——正在借鉴超休闲风格的活动循环。
创意方面也有两个突出趋势：风格化的 AI 生成视频钩子，以及日益增长的 UA 广告“大亨化”（tycoonisation）。

37Games 的 Last Asylum: Plague 在 8 月 10 日至 16 日期间创造了 380 万美元的周 IAP 收入新高。

Liftoff 上市后首个季度收入达 2.2 亿美元

Pokémon TCG Pocket declines dent Dena financials
Japanese game-maker Dena said that revenue in its game business was down 33% year-on-year in its latest financials, driven mostly by declines in revenue from Pokémon TCG Pocket.
While revenue is down on Dena’s flagship game, MAU remains relatively steady at 23m, down from an average of 24m across the previous quarter.
AppMagic estimates
suggest the game has fallen from earning roughly $40-45m per month in IAPs for most of 2025 to around $25m in the first half of 2026. The data says IAP earnings dipped further in June and July, averaging under $20m for the first time since launch in late 2024.
CrazyLabs’ Sled Surfers drives mobile growth at Embracer
Embracer’s net sales rose 24% year-on-year
to $414m (SEK3,943m) in its fiscal Q1, with Cash EBIT swinging to $4.9m (SEK47m) from -$10.4m (-SEK99m) a year earlier.
The Embracer operating segment – which includes mobile alongside PC/console, distribution and retro – grew net sales 48% to $329m (SEK3,134m), while the newly separated Fellowship Entertainment segment (Kingdom Come: Deliverance, Tomb Raider, Metro) fell 23% to $85m (SEK810m).
Within the Embracer segment, the company said its mobile business kept growing in both net sales and profitability, driven by CrazyLabs’ Sled Surfers – though as with mobile generally, no standalone figures were broken out explicitly in Embracer’s reporting.
My Hero Academia: United Survival tops 1m downloads a week after launch
KLab and gumi’s roguelite hero-action game
My Hero Academia: United Survival passed 1m downloads worldwide
within a week of its August 6 global launch.
To mark the milestone, the studios are running a login bonus event handing out character enlistment tickets through August 31.
Record MapleStory numbers drive revenue at Nexon
Nexon’s Q2 2026 revenue rose 2% year-on-year to $747m (¥121.1bn), while operating income fell 17% to $193m (¥31.3bn) as the company absorbed higher creator fees, user acquisition costs and cloud service costs.
The MapleStory franchise delivered a record quarter, up 63% year-on-year, while Arc Raiders passed 16.3m cumulative unit sales and generated $113m (¥18.3bn) in the quarter alone.
Citing a $5.2bn (¥842bn) cash reserve built up partly through recent investment divestitures,
Nexon announced a special dividend
of ¥415 per share, worth roughly $2bn (¥324bn) in total and subject to board approval in September, taking total shareholder returns since its 2011 IPO past $5.6bn (¥900bn) by the end of the year.
Shooters lead midcore genre revenue gains in Q2 says AppMagic
AppMagic’s Midcore Insights Q2 2026 report
estimates that the Shooter genre was the only major midcore genre to grow revenue year-on-year, up 13.9% to $845.3m, while RPG (-16.9%), Strategy (-10.2%) and Simulation (-14.8%) all declined.
While downloads grew within the Strategy genre, revenue didn’t keep pace. Card Battlers’ revenue fell an estimated 50.7% despite flat install numbers, largely on the back of Pokémon TCG Pocket’s decline.
AppMagic also flagged more 4X titles – including Whiteout Survival and Puzzles & Survival – borrowing hypercasual-style event loops.
Two creative trends stood out, too; stylised AI-generated video hooks, and a growing “tycoonisation” of UA ads.
Last Asylum: Plague hits a $3.8m weekly revenue high
37Games’ Last Asylum: Plague posted a new weekly IAP revenue high of $3.8m for August 10-16.
According to
AppMagic estimates
, that pushes it to sixth place in the midcore 4X Strategy market by weekly revenue – five months after launch – overtaking Puzzles & Survival ($3.5m) and Evony: The King’s Return ($3.2m).
AppMagic linked the growth to the game’s “Era of Revival” content update in mid-July, alongside a run of strong-performing ad creative that opens with an AI-generated hook tied to the game’s plot – a trend it’s also spotted in Whiteout Survival and Kingshot. Weekly installs rose to 918k even before the update landed, up 80% in just two weeks.
We first covered the game’s early momentum in April
, when it had already made the “strongest start” of any title in 37Games’ 4X portfolio.
Liftoff posts $220m revenue in its first quarter since IPO
Liftoff Mobile’s Q2 2026 revenue reached $220m
, up 35% year-on-year and marking its eleventh consecutive quarter of growth, with adjusted EBITDA up 55% to $132m at a 60% margin.
It’s the ad-tech and monetisation firm’s first earnings report since its June IPO on the Nasdaq. Liftoff guided to $217-222m in Q3 revenue and $870-880m for the full year.

Geoff Keighley 澄清 Gamescom Opening Night Live 预告片入选流程 | GamesIndustry.biz

如果你通过链接购买商品，我们可能会获得少量佣金。
阅读我们的编辑政策。

在下周 Gamescom 大会开幕前的媒体预沟通会上，Geoff Keighley 对将于周二举行的 Opening Night Live 数字展示会中预告片入选流程做了一些说明。

Keighley 也是 The Game Awards 的主持人。去年12月，Kotaku 报道称，在 2025 年颁奖典礼上播放一段 60 秒预告片的费用据称高达 45 万美元。去年夏天，Aftermath 报道称，在 Keighley 主持的 Opening Night Live 中，一段 60 秒预告片据称花费 10.25 万欧元（11.96 万美元）。

但在去年8月接受 GamesIndustry.biz 采访时，德国游戏行业协会 Game 的总经理 Felix Falk 表示，在 Opening Night Live 中放置预告片是免费的。他说：“当然，你可以在 Opening Night Live 中投放一些广告，但绝大多数内容都是免费的。无论你是 3A 大作还是独立游戏，只要你的内容足够出色，Geoff 就会决定让你进入节目，而且不需要你花一分钱。”

今天，在媒体预沟通会的问答环节中，GamesIndustry.biz 向 Keighley 提问，询问在 Opening Night Live 中放置预告片需要多少费用，以及什么构成广告。

Gears of War E-Day 已确认将出现在下周的 Opening Night Live 中 | 图片来源：The Coalition/Xbox Game Studios

他说，Opening Night Live 既有编辑选择的内容，也有付费投放的内容。他说：“就像公司会在 Gamescom 购买展位和场地一样，他们也会在节目内获得空间。”

“我认为对我们所有人来说，重要的一点是，有一些游戏是因为编辑价值而被选入节目的。我们也会收录很多独立游戏。你会看到许多小团队、由三四人制作的游戏入选 ONL，因为我们相信这些作品，我们相信这些团队，并希望支持他们。”

他补充说，这些节目是“营销活动，就像 Gamescom 本身就是营销活动一样，所以从很多方面来说，你们都可以认为这一切都是在营销游戏，但在所有节目中，确实有一些游戏是我们出于编辑考量而选择的。”

GamesIndustry.biz 询问，是否只有 Keighley 选择的游戏才能免费进入 Opening Night Live，而其他人都必须付费。他回答说，这是“一个集体决定。”

“我还要说，节目中的游戏，尤其是 ONL 中的游戏，在某种程度上都是 Gamescom 的合作伙伴。我们合作的公司已经以某种形式出现在 Gamescom 上，作为参展商或其他类似身份，而这也可能是他们在展位所做的事情的数字延伸。”

Metro 2039 也是 Opening Night Live 的一部分 | 图片来源：4A Games/Deep Silver

同样参加预沟通会的 Falk 补充说，“我们在数字方面所做的大部分工作都不是付费的，也不是软文或广告，”而是“对我们的合作伙伴免费。”他说，Gamescom 将数字节目视为一种“混合方式”，旨在将活动的影响力扩展到全球，“而不仅仅是面向现场超过 35 万人。”

他说：“对我们来说，经济上首先并不重要，不是要通过数字节目赚钱，而是要为参加 Gamescom 的合作伙伴提供覆盖。”

Keighley 还就游戏如何被选为编辑投放位置进行了一些说明。他说：“编辑选择的一部分因素实际上取决于新闻或公告的规模。”

“每个人都想看到全新且令人兴奋的东西，从而感到惊喜。公司和合作伙伴通常凭借他们为节目带来的新闻级别赢得编辑位置。”但他指出，节目中也会有一些“几周后发售的游戏——这更像是对现有游戏的广告。”

Keighley 确认 Gears of War E-Day 将成为 Opening Night Live 的一部分，此外还有 Final Fantasy 7: Revelation、Ananta、Metro 2039，以及《The Witcher 3 新扩展包》的更多细节。

Koelnmesse 的 Gamescom 总监 Tim Endres 也在预沟通会上指出，GDQ（Games Done Quick）今年将首次参加 Gamescom，为 Gaming for Democracy 倡议筹集资金。他说：“通过此举，我们再次将 Gamescom 作为一个公益平台，这对我们来说非常重要。”

Gamescom 2026 有望成为有史以来最大的一届，将有来自 40 个国家的近 50 个展馆和超过 1,600 家参展商。

In a press pre-briefing ahead of next week's Gamescom conference, Geoff Keighley has shed some light on the process of how trailers are selected for the Opening Night Live digital showcase, which will take place on Tuesday.
Keighley is also the host of The Game Awards, and in December,
Kotaku
reported that it allegedly cost up to $450,000 to place a 60-second trailer in the 2025 awards ceremony. Last summer,
Aftermath
reported that a 60-second trailer in the Keighley-hosted Opening Night Live allegedly cost €102,500 ($119,600).
But in
an interview
with
GamesIndustry.biz
last August, Felix Falk, managing director of Game, the German Games Industry Association, said that it was free to place a trailer in Opening Night Live. "Of course, you can place some advertisements in Opening Night Live, but the vast majority of the content is free," he said. "No matter if you're a AAA title or indie, as long as your content is brilliant, Geoff will decide to put you in a show, and it doesn't cost you a penny."
Today, in a Q&A session during the press pre-briefing,
GamesIndustry.biz
asked Keighley to clarify what it costs to put a trailer in Opening Night Live, and what constitutes an advertisement.
Gears of War E-Day has been confirmed to be part of next week's Opening Night Live  |
Image credit:
The Coalition/Xbox Game Studios
He said that Opening Night Live featured both editorial placements and paid placements. "Much like companies will purchase a booth at Gamescom and buy space, they'll secure space inside of the show," he said.
"One of the things that's important I think to all of us is that there are games that get selected for editorial value in the show. There's also a lot of independent games that we take. You'll see many small teams, games made by three, four people, that get selected to be inside of ONL, because we believe in those titles, and we believe in those teams and want to support them."
He added that these shows are "marketing events, just like Gamescom is a marketing event, so you can consider everything in many ways is marketing video games, but there are definitely games that we select for editorial consideration in all the shows."
GamesIndustry.biz
asked for clarification on whether only games that Keighley selects get into Opening Night Live for free, while everyone else has to pay. He replied that it's "a group decision."
"And I would also say the games that are inside, especially ONL, they're all partners to Gamescom in a way. So the companies that we're working with are already at Gamescom in some form as an exhibitor or something like that, and this is maybe a digital extension of what they're doing with their booths."
Metro 2039 is also part of Opening Night Live  |
Image credit:
4A Games/Deep Silver
Falk, who also took part in the pre-briefing, added that "the vast majority of everything we do on the digital side is not paid and is not advertorial or advertisement," and is instead "free for our partners." He said that Gamescom regarded the digital shows as a "hybrid approach" to extend the reach of the event worldwide, "not just addressing those more than 350,000 people on site."
"It's also economically not important for us to make money with the digital shows first, but to give reach to our partners who are at Gamescom," he said.
Keighley also gave some clarification on how games are selected to be editorial placements. "Part of the thing with the editorial selection is really it's the scale of the news or the announcement," he said.
"Everyone wants to tune in to be surprised with something brand new and exciting. Companies and partners often earn the ability to have editorial places with the level of news that people are bringing to the show." But he noted that the show also features "games that are shipping a few weeks later – that's more advertisement of a game that exists."
Keighley confirmed that Gears of War E-Day will be a part of Opening Night Live, along with Final Fantasy 7: Revelation, Ananta, Metro 2039, and more details on the new
expansion for The Witcher 3
.
Tim Endres, director of Gamescom at Koelnmesse, also noted during the pre-briefing that GDQ (Games Done Quick) will be at Gamescom for the first time this year, raising money for the Gaming for Democracy initiative. "With this, we are using Gamescom once again as a platform for a good cause, and that is really important to us," he said.
Gamescom 2026 is set to be the biggest ever, with
nearly 50 pavilions from 40 countries and more than 1,600 exhibitors

这家VC机构将同样的先行者逻辑应用于Skich——这家总部位于塞浦路斯的替代应用商店初创公司在欧盟《数字市场法案》迫使苹果允许替代应用商店之前就获得了Gem的投资。Skich最近与Xsolla签署了一项支付协议，将开发者佣金调整为统一的15%。

Gurskiy表示，Gem越来越倾向于投资那些已在高度相关品类中成功推出过游戏的创始人，有时甚至在游戏可玩版本或表现数据出现之前就进行投资。

这正是其投资Studio 42背后的理念。Studio 42是一家总部位于塞浦路斯的移动游戏工作室，由前Belka Games核心成员Aleksandr Bogdanov、Ivan Larionov和Pavel Sudakov创立。Studio 42在Play Ventures领投的种子轮中筹集了360万美元，Gem也参与了该轮融资。Gurskiy指出，该团队在打造《Solitaire Cruise》和《Clockmaker》等Belka旗下产品时展现的扩张能力，是其在游戏发布前就决定支持该工作室的基础。

Gurskiy还表示，证明一款游戏商业可行性的门槛已大幅提高，因为投资者不再满足于留存率数据，而是期望看到证据表明：在用户获取成本大幅攀升的背景下，一款游戏的收入在规模化投放后仍能保持稳定。

他补充道，Gem希望创始人在游戏核心假设不成立时，有“B计划，而且往往还要有C计划和D计划”。

像《Indika》开发商Odd Meter这样的独立团队也在Gem的狩猎名单上，因为“他们以低得多的预算运营，但成功的项目仍然能产生非凡的回报，”Gurskiy补充道。

“尽管纪律、数据指标和执行比以往任何时候都更重要，但游戏行业依然在回报那些敢于追求宏大创意愿景的团队。”

After that Sensor Tower-AppMagic deal, VC firm Gem seeks veteran founders, first movers and indies – Mobilegamer.biz
Skip to content
VC firm Gem Capital says it is looking for founders with a strong track record, first movers and high-potential indies for its next investment.
Gem is coming off a strong payout from
Sensor Tower’s acquisition of AppMagic
earlier this year. Co-managing director Kirill Gurskiy (pictured above right) said Gem backed AppMagic because the team spotted a gap for a dedicated small-medium business-focused analytics tool before anyone else built one.
The VC firm applied the same first-mover logic to Skich, the Cyprus-based alt store startup it backed before the EU’s Digital Markets Act forced Apple to allow alternative app stores. Skich
recently signed a payments deal with Xsolla
to move to a flat 15% commission for developers.
Gurskiy said Gem increasingly wants founders who’ve already shipped a successful game in a closely related genre, sometimes investing before a playable build or performance data exist.
That’s the idea behind its backing of Studio 42, the Cyprus-based mobile studio founded by former Belka Games leaders Aleksandr Bogdanov, Ivan Larionov and Pavel Sudakov. Studio 42 raised $3.6m in a Play Ventures-led seed round that Gem also joined. Gurskiy pointed to the team’s track record scaling Belka titles like Solitaire Cruise and Clockmaker as the basis for backing the studio pre-launch.
Gurskiy also said the bar for proving a game’s commercial viability has risen sharply as investors no longer stop at retention numbers, but now expect evidence that a title’s revenue can hold up once user acquisition spend is scaled, given how much UA costs have climbed.
He added that Gem wants founders with a “Plan B, and often Plan C and Plan D” if a game’s core hypothesis doesn’t pan out.
Indies like Indika maker Odd Meter are also on Gem’s shopping list, as they “operate with significantly lower budgets, yet successful projects can still generate exceptional returns,” adds Gurskiy.
“While discipline, metrics, and execution matter more than ever, the gaming industry continues to reward teams willing to pursue ambitious creative ideas.”

标题：一个你没听过的发行商，为何在 Gamescom 豪掷数百万参展？

正文：
为什么一个你可能没听说过的发行商要花费数百万美元参加 Gamescom | GamesIndustry.biz
如果你点击链接并购买商品，我们可能会获得少量佣金。
请阅读我们的编辑政策。
走在 Gamescom 的展馆中，你看到的最大、最精美的展位通常会附带一个同样大且耳熟能详的名字。这里有 Capcom、Xbox、Sega、EA、Ubisoft 等等。但在今年的展会上，6 号和 7 号馆的一大片区域将被一个你可能不太熟悉的名字占据：4Divinity。
“无论以何种标准衡量，这都规模巨大，”4Divinity 英国实体总监 Philip Doust 谈到该发行商的 Gamescom 参展时说。4Divinity 将携六款作品进入闭门 B2B 区域，其中五款亮相相关的预告片展示，四款在 B2C 展区的两个独立展台上展出，其中最大的展台面积达 800 平方米。这家发行商不仅在场地上全力以赴，在视觉效果上也是如此。“我们请来了 Gamescom 最好的展台搭建商之一，”Doust 说。“在这方面毫不吝啬。”
Philip Doust  |
图片来源：
4Divinity
例如，80 年代流行文化 RPG《Showa American Story》的区域设有一个重建的好莱坞山——在游戏平行时间线中，这座山被改名为新横滨山，而美国由日本统治。“我们有一座七米高的金门大桥，上面挂着日本灯笼，”Doust 补充道。“我们还重建了一家 diner，你可以走进去玩游戏。一切都是非常体验式的。”
所以，当 Doust 说毫不吝啬时……
“我不能谈（确切）数字，那太俗气了，”他回答说，“但这是数百万美元的投资。仅从我们的展台规模来看，就应该清楚我们在以这种级别进行投资。我认为这反映了我们对西方市场的重视程度。这并非每家中国公司都会做，或知道怎么做。”
唱片骑师
这暗示了为什么你可能没听说过一家有能力在 Gamescom 上花费如此之多的公司。4Divinity 只是总部位于新加坡的集团 GCL Global Holdings 旗下几家游戏公司之一（集团旗下还有一家仿钻珠宝制造商）。Doust 解释说，GCL“主要通过一家名为 Epicsoft 的实体分销公司建立起来，该公司已运营近 20 年”。显然，鉴于索尼最近的公告，这目前是一门棘手的生意。
《Showa American Story》发生在一个被日本文化殖民的美国  |
图片来源：
NEKCOM Entertainment/4Divinity
“这仍然是集团业务的重要组成部分，只要索尼允许，只要还有光盘可生产，我们就会继续做下去，”Doust 说。“但我们认识到这是一项正在下滑的业务，如果这是业务的主体，那么我们显然需要更偏向数字化的东西。”
由此诞生了 4Divinity，它最初于 2022 年成立，作为希望将游戏带入东南亚的西方公司的联合发行商。“找到一款能在亚洲——尤其是中国——表现出色的（西方）游戏非常困难，”Doust 说。“我们在《Atomic Heart》上做到了——中国是《Atomic Heart》的巨大市场——然后我们在《Stalker 2》上复制了这一点。但我们认识到这些游戏属于例外情况。”
“我们现在产品组合中有八款游戏，都将在未来两年内推出”
换句话说，这两项业务都不太可能带来 GCL 作为纳斯达克上市公司所需的增长。“从增长角度来看，那时候必须转向全球发行，”Doust 说。于是 4Divinity 开始签约中国制作的游戏，在全球发行。这一过程在 Doust 于 2024 年底加入公司之前就已开始——“他们已经签了两三款游戏；几款小型独立游戏，但还有《Showa American Story》，这对我们来说是一个重大动作”——但此后规模只增不减。“我们现在产品组合中有八款游戏，都将在未来两年内推出，”Doust 说。“所以这是一个巨大的增长期。”
这个初步阵容有一些共通的脉络：“我们所有的游戏主要是单人游戏。它们有 15 到 20 小时的体验时长。价格定位在中档。”
4Divinity 正押注于 AA 级游戏受众，例如《Sword Sage: Awakening》  |
图片来源：
Sword Panda Limited/4Divinity
他说，这未必是事先计划好的，但它已经形成了一条坚实的战略：瞄准常被讨论的游戏行业“被挤压的中间地带”（美国公司 ProbablyMonsters 也在追求这一战略）。
“对我来说，这正是当前人们从游戏中想要的东西的核心，”Doust 说。“他们没有 200 小时投入一款服务型游戏。80 美元的游戏，可能只留给一两款（作品）。但我认为人们愿意为一款单人体验投入 40 到 50 美元。”

Why a publisher you've probably not heard of is spending millions of dollars on its Gamescom presence | GamesIndustry.biz

Read our editorial policy

Walking the halls of Gamescom, the biggest, most elaborate booths you'll see will generally have an equally big, familiar name attached. Here's Capcom, Xbox, Sega, EA, Ubisoft, and so on. But at this year's event, a significant chunk of Halls 6 and 7 will be taken up by a name you probably won't be so familiar with: 4Divinity.
"It's enormous by any standard," says Philip Doust, director of 4Divinity's UK entity, of the publisher's Gamescom presence. 4Divinity is bringing six titles to the behind-closed-doors B2B area, five of them to the associated trailer showcases, and four to the B2C showfloor on two separate stands, the biggest of which spans 800 square metres. The publisher is going all out, not only in footprint, but also in spectacle. "We're using one of the best booth builders in Gamescom," Doust says. "There's been no expense spared on that front."
Philip Doust  |
Image credit:
4Divinity
The area for '80s pop-culture RPG
Showa American Story
, for example, features a rebuilt version of the Hollywood Hills – which have been rebranded the Neo Yokohama Hills in the game's alternative timeline, where the United States is ruled by Japan. "We have a Golden Gate Bridge that stands seven metres high, with the Japanese lanterns on it," Doust adds. "We have a diner we've recreated that you walk into to play the game. It's all very experiential."
So, when Doust says no expense spared…
"I can't talk [exact] figures, that would be crass," he replies, "but it's millions of dollars of investment. Just from that footprint we have, it should be clear we're investing to that kind of level. I think it's reflective of how seriously we're taking the western market. Which not every Chinese company necessarily does, or knows how to."
Disc jockeys
That's a hint to why you might not have heard of a company that can afford to spend this much on its Gamescom presence. 4Divinity is just one of several gaming companies under the umbrella of Singapore-based group GCL Global Holdings (there's also an imitation-diamond jewellery maker in the mix). GCL "was primarily built on a physical distribution business, through a company called Epicsoft, that has been going for nearly 20 years now," Doust explains. Obviously, that's a tricky business right now, given
Sony's recent announcements
.
Showa American Story takes place in a United States that has been culturally colonised by Japan  |
Image credit:
NEKCOM Entertainment/4Divinity
"It's still a significant part of our business as a group, and we'll continue to do it as long as Sony allows, as long as there are discs to produce," Doust says. "But we recognise that it's a declining business, and if that's where the mainstay of the business was, clearly we needed something that was more on the digital side."
Hence 4Divinity, which was originally launched in 2022 as a co-publisher for western companies wanting to bring their games to Southeast Asia. "Finding a [western] game that excels in Asia – China specifically – is very tough," Doust says. "We pulled it off with
Atomic Heart
– China was a huge market for Atomic Heart – and then we replicated that with Stalker 2. But we recognised that these games were kind of outliers."
"We're now up to eight games in the portfolio, all coming out within the next two years"
In other words, neither business was likely to bring the kind of growth required by GCL, as a Nasdaq-listed company. "From a growth perspective, it really had to be global publishing at that point," Doust says. And so 4Divinity began signing Chinese-made games to publish around the world. It was a process that began before Doust joined the company in late 2024 – "they'd already signed two or three games; a couple of smaller indies, but also Showa American Story, which is a big play for us" – but things have only scaled up from there. "We're now up to eight games in the portfolio, all coming out within the next two years," Doust says. "So it's been a huge growth period."
This initial line-up has a few strands of connective tissue: "All our games are predominantly single player. They're 15–20 hour experiences. They're mid-tier priced."
4Divinity is betting on an audience for AA titles with games like Sword Sage: Awakening  |
Image credit:
Sword Panda Limited/4Divinity
This wasn't necessarily the plan in advance, he says, but it's formed into a solid strategy: to target the oft-discussed squeezed middle of games (a strategy that's
also being pursued by US firm ProbablyMonsters
).
"This, for me, is exactly the crux of what people want from games right now," Doust says. "They don't have 200 hours to put into a live service. The $80 game, that's probably reserved for one or two [titles]. But I think people are willing to invest $40–50 into a single-player experience."
Even if most businesses aren't. Doust understands why: "These are games that cost between $5 million and $20 million to make, roughly. Whether you're in China or the West, that's a big investment." With all the other associated operating costs, "you need that game to sell a million units just to break even. That's not very attractive, because a million units these days is tough. Discoverability is an issue. We all know this."
Fresh faces
Targeting the AA sector is not the only thing 4Divinity is doing differently. "Everything you're going to see at Gamescom is new IP. Even in China, it's all new to games, at least. But in the west – absolutely new IP," Doust says. "Bigger companies are not taking bets on
one
new IP, let alone six." Given the rising costs of game development, "AAA has become so risk averse that it's become a franchise business. Unless you [already] have a franchise, you're not in that game, generally. Apart from some emerging Chinese companies."

Hundreds of union workers rally across North America to protest Xbox layoffs
CWA members and supporters are keeping pressure on Microsoft after the company announced plans to eliminate 3,200 roles across Xbox during the current fiscal year.
Chris Kerr
,
Senior Editor, News
,
GameDeveloper.com
August 20, 2026
2 Min Read
Image via CWA
Hundreds of unionized video game workers amassed outside Xbox studios across the United States and Canada this week to protest the latest round of mass layoffs within Microsoft's video game division.
Union members represented by the Communications Workers of America (CWA) and local labor allies staged another round of 'Save Our Devs' rallies on August 19, 2026, in Austin, Dallas, Seattle, Rockville, Hunt Valley, Montreal, and Minneapolis.
The first 'Save Our Devs' rallies were held in July
.
The CWA said workers gathered to call out "layoffs and corporate greed across the industry" and to demand fair first contracts across Microsoft's vast portfolio of video game studios—which are currently being subjected to their fifth round of layoffs in three years.
In July, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma said Xbox must "reset" to find a path forward and confirmed the division will be
eliminating 3,200 jobs
before the end of the current fiscal year—starting with 1,600 immediate layoffs within notable subsidiaries including Obsidian, id Software, and ZeniMax Online Studios. Those cuts impacted hundreds of union workers.
Related:
Makers Fund expands game industry footprint through $250 million investment round
Other studios such as Double Fine, Undead Labs, Ninja Theory, and Compulsion Games have been divested by the Xbox maker,
leading to layoffs at the former
.
The CWA and CWA Canada are currently
taking legal action against Microsoft
for allegedly mishandling the cuts. In response, Microsoft said it reached out to the union to begin effects bargaining and remains committed to that process.
During candid conversations with Game Developer shortly after the layoffs were announced, multiple Xbox workers claimed the video game division is
on the brink of falling apart
after losing thousands of workers—representing centuries of production experience—in recent years. Those views were echoed by unionized Xbox workers who shared their opinions in a press release sent out by the CWA this week.
"Each of the 1,600 people from July's layoffs have their own unique tale, and every developer still employed at an Xbox studio lives in anxious fear, waiting to discover if they are one of the next 1600 stories," said id Software Principal Engine Programmer and CWA Local 6215 member John Roberts, who was laid off as part of July’s job cuts. "We cannot allow Microsoft to set a precedent of ignoring federal labor law, leaving so many union workers discarded."
Adding their views, Bethesda Game Studios quest designer and CWA Local 2108 member Stephanie Zachariadis, who was laid off in July, said Bethesda has lost so much veteran talent in recent years.

"When I first started working [at Bethesda Game Studios], I was in awe. I wanted nothing more than to contribute to the legacy created by the developers here: the people who forever changed my perception of what a video game could be like when I first played
Fallout 3
at eight years old," they added. “Now? The legends who filled those trophy cases are, for the most part, gone, laid off, or driven away.”
